title: test(ui/e2e): scope the list-no-actions-column mount wait to one element on every face

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbD5gxSWeWGswbZYVzNvtqNM)_

Fixes #36119

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改一份界面端到端测试,让它在任何执行顺序下都只等一个确定的元素。
- 为什么做:列表页无操作列这组验收测试里,侧边记录面板的用例会随测试顺序偶发失败。
- 出错会怎样:只影响这份测试是否误报,不影响产品;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

`ui/e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts` only. Both mount waits (the worker's first, throwaway mount and every mount after it) used `page.getByText('商机 1', { exact: true })`. On the `drawer` face that text is in two places — the list row's cell and the side record's `h1` — so whether strict mode throws depends on whether the first poll lands before or after the list's rows render. A new `mounted(page, c)` helper waits for exactly one element per face: the list row's cell (`page.locator('tr').getByText(...)`) on the list and drawer faces, the record header's `heading` on the `tab` face, which has no list. No source edit, no `data-*` hook.

Read first: the `mounted` helper above `mount()` — the only risk hunk is that the `tab` face now waits on the heading by role instead of by text (same element, it was the only match there).

## Tests

Local, chromium, `--trace off`, through a scratch Playwright config with no `webServer` (this spec bundles its own page with vite and needs no console build; `@objectstack/{spec,formula,client,sdui-parser,lint}` built first).

<details><summary>Locator counts on the drawer face, after mount (probe copy of the pre-fix spec, deleted after)</summary>

```
PROBE drawer light 2 1 1   # getByText('商机 1') = 2 · tr-scoped = 1 · heading = 1
PROBE tab 0 1              # tab face: tr-scoped = 0 · heading = 1
```
</details>

<details><summary>Red reading on origin/main: NOT reproduced locally</summary>

The side-record cases run alone, first in their worker, on base `4e55e4eb`: 7 runs (light ×3, dark ×2, 375px ×2), 7 passed. The race goes the other way on this box (the first poll sees only the `h1`); the probe above shows the two-element match the card reports is real once the rows are in.
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix (head 395ea5d0, same spec bytes as the merge head)</summary>

- `-g 'light: the side record' --workers=1` (first in its worker): 1 passed
- `-g '375px, the side record' --workers=1`: 1 passed
- `-g 'a record page' --workers=1` (tab face): 2 passed
- whole spec `--workers=1`: 24 passed
- `list-.*\.spec\.ts` (8 spec files) `--workers=2`: 57 passed
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Test-only; no published surface, so `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

`cd ui && npx playwright test --trace off --workers=1 list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts -g 'the side record'` — expect 3 passed (light, dark, 375px).
